answer.rationale: Pursue an expedited incumbent renewal conditioned on benchmarked price and payment-term concessions sufficient to close the 18% spend-gap target as far as feasible. With expiry in 14 days and the line at 94% committed volume, switching primary supply or introducing a new source creates unacceptable qualification, delivery, and disruption risk despite prior low-cost-vendor success. The incumbent preserves proven integration and scheduled deliveries; prior evidence also indicates benchmarking and multi-year volume commitments can materially improve price and terms. Verify the archived negotiation record before committing because its specific savings and conditions determine whether the target is realistically attainable. If the incumbent cannot meet an acceptable benchmarked cost, document the residual gap and defer a primary-switch decision to the next review rather than jeopardize current production.
